_doc: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon with the stock 0.4 mm nozzle and Bambu Studio defaults. kind: spec (manufacturer), default (slicer setting), community (widely used rule of thumb), measured (your own test print; beats the rest), estimate (a reasoned guess: measure it).
name: x1c

line.rule: Bambu Studio's default line width for a 0.4 mm nozzle: walls are whole numbers of lines
line.source: Bambu Studio 0.4 mm nozzle process profile

layer.rule: Default layer height; heights that matter should be whole numbers of layers

wall_min.rule: Thinnest wall worth printing: two lines

hole_comp.rule: Printed holes and slots come out small: widen them by this much
hole_comp.source: Common FDM practice; tune with a test print

fit.rule: Gap between parts that slide together
fit.source: Common FDM practice; tune with a test print

print_gap.rule: Narrowest gap between parts printed in place, side by side, that still prints apart (a flexure and the frame round it, a shuttle in its slot): the gap each side, not the total
print_gap.source: A reasoned guess for a 0.42 mm line; measure it with the fit test plate (examples/bench/projects/launcher/objects/fittest)

slide_gap.rule: Gap each side between a loose part and the channel it slides in (the disc in its barrel): the widest the fit test plate tried, and the one that slid best
slide_gap.source: Fit test plate (launcher/fittest, PR #99): channels 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4 mm a side; 0.4 best (user, 2026-11-02)

pin_gap.rule: Radial clearance round a printed pin in its hole that holds best: the tightest the fit test plate tried
pin_gap.source: Fit test plate (launcher/fittest, PR #99): holes 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2 mm radial; 0.05 best (user, 2026-11-02)

overhang.rule: Steepest overhang from vertical that prints without supports

bridge.rule: Widest gap a flat underside can span with no support (the widest circle that fits in it)

support_gap.rule: Gap between a built-in breakaway support and the part: one layer, so it snaps off

chamfer.rule: Chamfer bottom edges instead of rounding them, against first-layer squish

foot.rule: How far the first layer spreads each side as it is squashed on to the bed (elephant's foot): two parts printed in place must stand print_gap plus twice this apart there, or they print as one
foot.source: Bambu Studio's default elephant foot compensation, 0.15 mm, the amount it shrinks the first layer by to undo the spread

press.rule: How much smaller across a printed bore is than a bought part pressed into it, once printed (a ball bearing's outer race): hole_comp is added as well
press.source: A reasoned guess, half a typical 0.1 mm hole error; measure it with the seats coupon (examples/bench/projects/benchmarks/objects/seats-coupon)

slip.rule: How much larger across a printed bore is than a bought part that slides into it by hand, once printed: hole_comp is added as well
slip.source: A reasoned guess; measure it with the seats coupon (examples/bench/projects/benchmarks/objects/seats-coupon)

print_flow.rule: Average plastic laid per second over a whole print, walls, travel and all: for estimating minutes from a part's volume
print_flow.source: A rule of thumb for a 0.4 mm nozzle on default settings; check it against a real print's time
